Today, its business spreads from retail to real estate, shopping malls and manufacturing, rightly gaining popularity as Artee Group.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Outlet Concept Manager - Fresh

Job Locations: Abuja, Lagos, Enugu and Rivers

Job Description


	The Outlet Concept Manager &ndash; Fresh Foods is responsible for the operational leadership, sales performance, stock availability, and profitability of the Fresh Foods section within SPAR stores.
	The role ensures effective management of all Fresh categories including Produce, Butchery, Fish, Deli, and other perishable items, ensuring strict compliance with quality, hygiene, and cold chain standards.
	In addition to operations, the Outlet Concept Manager drives key business metrics such as Sales, Margins, Shrinkage, Waste Control, and Customer Satisfaction, while ensuring effective execution of SPAR Fresh Food standards and processes. The role also serves as the operational Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Fresh Foods, responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing team capability in line with SPAR operational standards.


Key Responsibilities
Sales &amp; Revenue Performance:


	Drive sales growth and achievement of Fresh Food revenue targets.
	Monitor category performance and implement corrective actions.
	Support promotional activities, seasonal campaigns, and pricing strategies.
	Analyze sales trends and customer buying patterns.


Fresh Food Operations Management:


	Ensure product availability across all Fresh Food categories.
	Manage production planning, receiving, stock replenishment, and workflow efficiency.
	Maintain adherence to Fresh Food SOPs and operational standards.
	Ensure effective handling, storage, and display of fresh products.


Inventory &amp; Stock Management:


	Maintain optimum stock levels and product availability.
	Implement FIFO and FEFO practices.
	Monitor stock ageing, expiries, markdowns, and waste reduction initiatives.
	Conduct regular stock counts and reconciliations.


Merchandising &amp; Display Management:


	Ensure compliance with merchandising standards and planograms.
	Maintain attractive displays and shelf presentation.
	Ensure pricing accuracy and promotional execution.
	Maximize product visibility and customer convenience.


Quality Assurance &amp; Food Safety Compliance:


	Enforce food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.
	Monitor product freshness, shelf life, and cold chain compliance.
	Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
	Maintain audit readiness within Fresh departments.


Loss Prevention &amp; Operational Controls:


	Control shrinkage, waste, damages, and stock losses.
	Monitor stock movement and investigate discrepancies.
	Ensure proper documentation and inventory controls.
	Support internal audits and governance reviews.


Team Leadership &amp; Workforce Management:


	Lead supervisors, CSAs, stock handlers, and Fresh Food teams.
	Plan manpower requirements and staff schedules.
	Monitor productivity and departmental performance.
	Foster a culture of accountability, discipline, and teamwork.


Coaching, Training &amp; Capability Development:


	Conduct on-the-job training and operational coaching.
	Develop product knowledge and Fresh Food expertise within teams.
	Identify and groom successors for critical positions.
	Support leadership development initiatives.


Customer Experience &amp; Service Excellence:


	Promote a customer-first culture.
	Resolve customer complaints promptly and professionally.
	Ensure clean, organized, and attractive Fresh Food sections.
	Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.


Financial Management &amp; Reporting:


	Manage Fresh Food budgets and departmental profitability.
	Monitor sales, margins, waste, markdowns, and shrinkage.
	Prepare operational and performance reports.
	Identify opportunities for cost optimization and efficiency improvement.


Method of Application&nbsp;

	We are seeking an experienced IT Internal Auditor to evaluate IT systems, processes, and infrastructure, identify risks, and strengthen security, compliance, and governance across the Group.

Finance & Account Manager Job at Jobtion Consulting




        
    

        
        Jobtion Consulting - Our client, a fast-growing organisation in the food and beverage distribution sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance & Account Manager

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are supporting a fast-growing organisation in the food and beverage distribution sector to recruit an experienced Finance & Accounts Manager.
	This is a strategic and hands-on finance leadership role for a commercially minded professional who can go beyond accounting and reporting to drive profitability, cash flow, financial controls, business intelligence and sound business decisions.
	The role reports directly to the MD / CEO and will play a key role in strengthening the finance function and supporting sustainable business growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.
	Drive cash-flow, working-capital and receivables management.
	Analyse profitability across products, customers, channels and territories.
	Partner with the MD/CEO and leadership team on financial and commercial decisions.
	Strengthen financial controls, compliance and risk management.
	Build dashboards and financial insights that support data-driven decisions.
	Improve finance systems, processes and automation as the business scales.
	Lead and develop a high-performing finance team.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
	5–8 years of progressive experience in Finance / Accounting, preferably within FMCG, distribution, trading, manufacturing or another fast-moving commercial environment.
	Professional accounting qualification such as ICAN, ACCA, ACA or equivalent is strongly preferred.
	Demonstrated experience in financial planning, management reporting, cash-flow management and commercial analysis.
	Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
	Experience using accounting/ERP systems; QuickBooks experience is an advantage.
	Proven experience working directly with senior management, CEOs, MDs or business owners.
	A track record of improving business performance through financial insight, stronger controls, systems improvement or commercial decision-making.


Salary
N1,000,000 – N1,500,000 gross monthly.

Head of Sales Job at Jobtion Consulting




        
    

        
        Jobtion Consulting - Our client, a Food and Beverage Distribution Company, is recruiting an experienced candidate to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head of Sales
Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: CEO / MD

Job Summary
     

            
    




	This is a strategic commercial leadership role for an ambitious commercial builder who can translate business ambitions into revenue growth, stronger distribution, market penetration and profitable commercial performance.
	The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO/MD and Commercial Director, leading the sales function across channels and territories while building the strategy, systems, team and commercial discipline required to scale the business.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the company's sales and commercial growth strategy.
	Own sales volume, revenue, distribution and market penetration targets.
	Develop growth plans across territories, channels, products, customers and distributors.
	Build a data-driven sales function using commercial dashboards, KPIs and performance insights.
	Lead, coach and develop a high-performing sales team.
	Drive route-to-market and distribution expansion across priority channels.
	Build and strengthen distributor, key account and customer relationships.
	Partner with Finance and leadership on revenue, margin, cash flow and commercial profitability.
	Establish robust sales forecasting, planning and performance management systems.
	Provide market intelligence and actionable commercial recommendations to senior leadership.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
	8–12+ years of progressive sales/commercial experience.
	At least 5 years in a senior sales or commercial leadership role.
	MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
	Strong FMCG, beverage, wine, spirits, food distribution or related sector experience.
	Proven experience managing multi-territory sales operations.
	Demonstrable track record of growing revenue, market share and distribution.
	Experience working with distributors, wholesalers, key accounts, modern trade and/or on-trade channels.
	Strong commercial intelligence, analytical ability and leadership capability.


Salary
N1,000,000 – N1,500,000 monthly.
